meta.source: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), product and UPI ecosystem statistics, captured by the local Data Bank
meta.vintageNote: NPCI publishes no revision date for its statistics and edits past rows in place without notice; these are its tables as the Data Bank captured them on the archiveCapturedDate.
meta.revisionPolicy: NPCI edits past rows in place without notice (it revised April 2023's UPI volume, and NETC's February and March 2026 in October 2026). Each capture is the table as NPCI then showed it; the Data Bank keeps every capture.
meta.coverage: Bulk credits through NACH each month since April 2013, by product: subsidies and benefits sent by Aadhaar number (APBS), and salary, pension, dividend and benefit credits sent by account number; presented, returned and successful, number and value
meta.note: NPCI's NACH credit table, by product and sub-product, counts and rupees as printed. Rows NPCI misfiled under mistyped years in 2026 and three rows shifted one column (NACH-306 DBT January 2022, the Total Credit row October 2022) are rejected by the Data Bank and are gaps here. Presented = returned + successful is checked in validate, with NPCI's own arithmetic slips (2013-07, 2014-09, 2016-03, 2020-10, 2022-09) kept as printed.
